entries.title: US launches fresh strikes as Iran closes Strait of Hormuz
entries.snippet: The strikes follow an attack on a Cyprus -flagged vessel travelling through the critical waterway.

entries.title: US Senator and close Trump ally Lindsey Graham dies after 'brief and sudden illness'
entries.snippet: The influential politician had just returned from Kyiv, where he met Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky on Friday.

entries.title: Badly burned British couple rescued from ravine during Spain wildfires, reports say
entries.snippet: The unnamed pair were found semi-conscious with 40% burns after being trapped by the blazes raging through Almeria province, according to local media

entries.title: China evacuates nearly two million people as powerful typhoon makes landfall
entries.snippet: Schools, work and outdoor activities have been suspended in Zhejiang province and many transport services cancelled.

entries.title: At least two killed in Toronto street festival shooting
entries.snippet: Police say there was an exchange of gunfire between two individuals at the festival, and two firearms had been recovered from the scene.

entries.title: T. rex could become most expensive fossil ever - but it's a ​problem for scientists
entries.snippet: A 67 million-year-old Tyrannosaurus rex will go on sale in New York with a pre-sale value of $30m.

entries.title: Trump administration subpoenas New York Times journalists over Air Force One reporting
entries.snippet: The reporters received the legal summons after they reported on alleged security issues with the president's new plane, which was gifted by Qatar.

entries.title: US Democrat Ro Khanna says he was detained by armed Israeli settlers
entries.snippet: Khanna, 49, was visiting the occupied West Bank when he was held for 90 minutes, he says.

entries.title: Muslim judge in India faces death threats after convicting 'cow vigilantes'
entries.snippet: Tabassum Khan has been facing online abuse after convicting 14 Hindu men in a lynching case.

entries.title: Polish PM pledges memorial to victims of WW2 'genocide by Ukrainian nationalists'
entries.snippet: Warsaw and Kyiv have for decades been at loggerheads over the killings of many thousands of civilians during World War Two.

entries.title: South Africa World Cup midfielder Adams dies aged 25
entries.snippet: South Africa and Mamelodi Sundowns midfielder Jayden Adams dies at the age of 25, just weeks after featuring for his country at the World Cup.

entries.title: More than 40 kidnapped children and teachers freed after Nigerian army operation
entries.snippet: "I feel happy and elated… I feel joy," the head of the local teachers' union tells the BBC.

entries.title: Indian tourists among 15 killed as speedboat capsizes in Vietnam
entries.snippet: Local media say 21 people were saved after the boat overturned in rough seas near an island in south Vietnam.

entries.title: How Aldi is taking on US supermarkets with its $4 almond butter
entries.snippet: The German supermarket's $9bn US push targets urban hubs like Manhattan. Can its discount model match Walmart?

entries.title: Ice on testicles and donating blood - the myths sold to men trying to boost their sperm
entries.snippet: With men’s fertility increasingly in the spotlight, we meet the men using unproven “hacks” promoted by influencers to up their sperm counts.

entries.title: How men with female surnames are standing up to ridicule in Kenya
entries.snippet: Children often inherit their father's first name as a surname, but traditions are changing and causing upset.

entries.title: Meet the crypto billionaires building a world where money buys you a vote
entries.snippet: They think democracy has run its course - so they're setting up their own nations instead.

entries.title: The photo that shows who's really on top in Le Pen's party
entries.snippet: Thirty-year-old Jordan Bardella had been groomed for success as France's next hard-right leader. He will now have to wait longer.

entries.title: People flee as Russian strike hits near Ukraine coffee shop
entries.snippet: Three cameras caught the moment people ducked then ran for cover in Sumy, in north eastern Ukraine.

entries.title: How a viral seal called Neil caused mayhem in Australia
entries.snippet: The five-year-old elephant seal attracted global attention during his recent time ashore in southern Tasmania.

entries.title: A Bible passage is at the center of a debate over how the U.S. should treat immigrants
entries.snippet: A debate over the Bible verse Matthew 25 is pitting mainline pastors, Black protestants and the pope against evangelical politicians put on the defensive over President Trump's policies.

entries.title: Could fish be a secret ingredient for rice farmers to avoid disease and make more money?
entries.snippet: Farmers in Senegal are welcoming fish into their rice paddies. The hope is they'll fertilize the crop, be a source of food ... and eat the snails that carry parasitic worms.

entries.title: Getting campaign text messages ahead of midterms? There could be an AI bot behind it
entries.snippet: Taught to sound like a candidate, bots are engaging voters with personalized text messages making AI-generated texting conversations the latest tool political campaigns are using to connect.

entries.title: What a Monopoly importer learned when it tried to make things in the U.S.A.
entries.snippet: After getting hit with tariffs for the imported board games he sells, Jonathan Silva decided to see if he could produce a version of his Monopoly game in the United States. This is what he learned.

entries.title: An artist brought 'I.C.E. pops' to a Texas campus. The show was shut down in days
entries.snippet: The Trump administration's executive orders have meant that administrators are questioning what art can — and can't — be seen on campus.

entries.title: Sen. Lindsey Graham of South Carolina, Trump ally and foreign policy hawk, dies at 71
entries.snippet: The Republican lawmaker's office said Graham died Saturday night after a "brief and sudden illness."

entries.title: Alvarez's 112th-minute goal helps lift Argentina past Switzerland 3-1 and into World Cup semifinals
entries.snippet: Julian Alvarez sent defending champion Argentina into the World Cup semifinals with a long-range strike in the 112th minute against Switzerland.

entries.title: Messi and Argentina survive another close call to reach the World Cup semifinals
entries.snippet: Argentina was taken to the brink in its first two knockout games. In Saturday's quarterfinal against Switzerland, the Albiceleste survived again to advance to the semis, where they will face England.

entries.title: 200 young campers rescued as flooding hits parts of Missouri and Kentucky
entries.snippet: A historic rainfall event has left communities across several Missouri counties underwater and prompted water rescues, including an evacuation of a summer camp.

entries.title: US attacks Iran over ship being hit in Strait of Hormuz; Tehran lashes out again at Gulf Arab states
entries.snippet: The United States attacked Iran early Sunday morning over an Iranian attack on a vessel in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran apparently responded with strikes targeting Bahrain, Qatar and the United Arab Emirates.

entries.title: Guggenheim Museum among NYC buildings that tested positive for Legionnaires' amid disease outbreak
entries.snippet: The city health department on Friday released a list of 31 buildings on the Upper East Side that have been ordered to clean and disinfect their cooling towers as the city deals with the latest outbreak of the disease.

entries.title: Sen. Whitehouse announces whistleblower allegations of construction problems at Kennedy Center
entries.snippet: Sheldon Whitehouse of Rhode Island said in a release on Saturday that he had received a whistleblower disclosure from the Government Accountability Project.

entries.title: Judge tosses remnants of Proud Boys seditious conspiracy case after Trump's broad clemency
entries.snippet: The judge who presided over the Proud Boys leaders' trial saw no basis to preserve the convictions after Trump's sweeping act of clemency last year.

entries.title: Rep. Ro Khanna says he was detained by the Israeli military and settlers in the West Bank
entries.snippet: A representative for Khanna, a California Democrat who is an outspoken progressive, said the confrontation occurred Wednesday in the middle of a three-day tour of the West Bank.

entries.title: New York Times reporters are subpoenaed after Air Force One stories, raising press freedom concerns
entries.snippet: The subpoenas seek to force the reporters to testify before a federal grand jury in Manhattan next week, the Times said, adding that federal agents delivered some subpoenas to the reporters at their homes.

entries.title: Typhoon Bavi makes landfall in eastern China as more than 1 million are evacuated
entries.snippet: Bavi previously brought strong winds and rain to Japan's southern islands and Taiwan. It was the second typhoon to impact China in just over a week's time.

entries.title: UK police make new arrest over killing of former politician Ann Widdecombe
entries.snippet: Devon and Cornwall Police said the suspect was arrested more than 200 miles from the southwest England village where Widdecombe was found dead.

entries.title: Fate of Strait of Hormuz challenges talks as Trump and Iran's supreme leader trade threats
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump overnight made threats on social media of further missile attacks against Iran, after the funeral of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei saw open calls for the U.S. leader's killing.

entries.title: U.S. citizen working for humanitarian organization in Congo tests positive for Ebola
entries.snippet: The CDC said it was working with the person's employer, U.S. agencies, the public health authorities and Congolese partners to prevent further transmission and identify close contacts.

entries.title: Missouri flooding leaves one dead, while rescuers helicopter more than 200 to safety at summer camp
entries.snippet: Several other states also faced the potential for severe thunderstorms and flash flooding as the slow moving storms moved southward.

entries.title: The EPA promised a MAHA agenda. It has yet to materialize, frustrating activists
entries.snippet: After Make America Healthy Again activists drew up a petition to get him fired, EPA administrator Lee Zeldin pledged to release a formal agenda of MAHA priorities his agency would pursue. But eight months after its first mention, the so-called MAHA agenda is nowhere to be found.

entries.title: Apple files lawsuit against OpenAI, accusing ChatGPT maker of stealing trade secrets
entries.snippet: Apple on Friday accused OpenAI of stealing trade secrets as it seeks to build its own hardware for ChatGPT, a major rupture in a partnership between the iPhone maker and the artificial intelligence company.

entries.title: Graham Platner submits notice to formally withdraw from Maine Senate race
entries.snippet: Maine is considered a key state for control of the narrowly divided Senate, and Democrats were desperate for a candidate capable of defeating Republican Sen. Susan Collins.

entries.title: A look at the new regulations and incentives in the housing bill set to become law
entries.snippet: A sweeping new housing bill is set to become law, even without the president's signature. The measure passed Congress with bipartisan support, but President Trump refused to sign it in protest of the GOP Senate's failure to approve his election legislation, known as the SAVE Act.

entries.title: What we know about Mitch McConnell's health and hospitalization
entries.snippet: There are questions surrounding the health of Sen. Mitch McConnell after the Kentucky Republican's hospitalization on June 14. Lisa Desjardins reports on what we know.

entries.title: Trump fires election commission members in latest attempt to control voting process
entries.snippet: With planning for the midterm elections well underway, President Trump has ousted the remaining members of a bipartisan federal agency that helps state and local officials run smooth elections and certify voting equipment. White House correspondent Liz Landers explains what happe

entries.title: What we know about death of Nolan Wells, Black teen who went missing on Mississippi boat trip
entries.snippet: The family of Nolan Wells, a Black teenager who was found dead after going missing on an island in Mississippi, made an emotional plea Friday for an honest, thorough investigation in a case that has captured national attention over its unanswered questions. "We just want to know

entries.title: News Wrap: DHS says man killed by ICE was not target of immigration operation
entries.snippet: In our news wrap Friday, the Department of Homeland Security says the man killed by an ICE agent in Houston was not the intended target of an immigration enforcement operation, the family of the teenager who died off the coast of Mississippi is calling for a thorough investigatio

entries.title: Where trans advocates are focusing efforts after recent court defeats
entries.snippet: The Supreme Court wrapped up one of its most consequential terms for shaping LGBTQ rights. In one of the major decisions, the justices upheld state bans on transgender athletes in girls' and women's sports. But more challenges are already emerging. Liz Landers reports on the lega

entries.title: Dry winter leaves farmers along Colorado River facing greater water shortages
entries.snippet: This past winter was an extraordinarily dry one in the western U.S. A lack of snowpack that normally feeds the Colorado River has only deepened the impact of a drought affecting tens of millions in seven states and Mexico. Accelerated by climate change, the drought is taking a bi

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Germany's Ruhr Valley is on brink of financial collapse
entries.snippet: With tax revenues down and social spending up, more and more cities and towns in the Ruhrgebiet are struggling to make ends meet. One city that is particularly deep in the red is Oberhausen.

entries.title: Germany news: Neuschwanstein killer fights extradition to US
entries.snippet: A man who murdered a woman at Neuschwanstein Castle says he fears execution in the US. Germany has been hit by another heat wave, though no records are likely to be broken this time, forecasters say. DW has more.

entries.title: Qatar: Former Emir Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani dies at 74
entries.snippet: The former Emir led Qatar's transformation from a small Gulf state into one of the world's wealthiest nations and oversaw the launch of Al Jazeera and the country's World Cup bid.

entries.title: How a Jewish heir is taking on Germany's far-right AfD
entries.snippet: Heavily supported in eastern states, the Alternative for Germany is using a GDR cultural icon, the Schwalbe moped, in its campaigning. Now, the Jewish heir of the manufacturer is fighting to protect his family's legacy.

entries.title: US: Reporters subpoenaed over Air Force One stories
entries.snippet: New York Times journalists who reported on security fears about the president's new Qatari-gifted plane have been called to court. The case raises concerns about press freedoms under the Trump administration.

entries.title: US Senator Lindsey Graham dies
entries.snippet: The South Carolina politician and staunch ally of Donald Trump died aged 71 after ​a brief and sudden illness, his office said. The hawkish senator backed the 2003 invasion of Iraq and the more recent war with Iran.

entries.title: Gas queues grow as Ukraine targets Russia's fuel supply
entries.snippet: Attacks by Ukraine have triggered a fuel crisis in Russia. Reports from across Russia show how residents are dealing with the disruptions in their daily lives.

entries.title: Two people killed and several wounded in mass shooting at Toronto festival
entries.snippet: The shooting happened during a salsa event, Canada's largest Latin street festival. Toronto police say two gunmen were responsible but that the suspects have not been detained yet.

entries.title: Iran closes Strait of Hormuz, US launches fresh strikes
entries.snippet: The Iranian navy has said it closed the Strait of Hormuz after firing on a vessel transiting an "unapproved route." In response, the US launched a third set of strikes on Iran this week. Follow DW for more.

entries.title: Spain wildfire: Firefighters begin to contain deadly blaze
entries.snippet: Firefighters have started to rein in the wildfire that killed 12 people in the southern Andalusia region, which is home to one of Spain's largest expat communities.

entries.title: Heat is especially hard on people taking antidepressants
entries.snippet: High temperatures can increase the risk of dizziness, dehydration, exhaustion and other heat-related problems for people taking antidepressants.

entries.title: Typhoon Bavi hits China after battering Taiwan, Japan
entries.snippet: Bavi has forced hundreds of thousands to evacuate in China, knocked out power in Japan and Taiwan, and triggered deadly landslides in the Philippines.

entries.title: Indian tourists killed when boat capsizes in Vietnam
entries.snippet: The Indian Embassy released the names of all 32 Indians who were aboard the boat that capsized near Phu Quoc island in Vietnam. At least 15 of them died.

entries.title: Germany: Left-wing group says it is behind railway sabotage
entries.snippet: The "Angry Birds Commando" group said they placed incendiary devices on a railroad between the two busy cities of Cologne and Düsseldorf. The group blamed industrial technology for the destruction of the environment.

entries.title: Germany's richest man takes on Big Tech
entries.snippet: Dieter Schwarz made his fortune from supermarkets, becoming Germany's wealthiest person. Now he wants to take on Google, Microsoft and Amazon and an entire region stands to benefit.

entries.title: Russia hits Ukraine's Kyiv, Odesa in fresh attacks
entries.snippet: The strikes come with Ukraine running low on munitions needed to counter Russia's ballistic missiles. Ukrainian President Zelenskyy urged NATO members to deliver on promises made at the Ankara summit this week.

entries.title: Iran's Mojtaba Khamenei vows revenge for father's killing
entries.snippet: Iran's supreme leader said Iran "demands" retribution for his father's assassination in an airstrike. Meanwhile, Trump has threatened to "completely decimate" Iran should it attempt to assassinate him.

entries.title: India news: US to seek Lawrence Bishnoi's extradition
entries.snippet: US authorities have confirmed that they want to extradite Lawrence Bishnoi, who was charged with the killing of Sikh separatist leader Hardeep ​Singh Nijjar in Canada. Follow DW for more.

entries.title: Berlin hostage crisis: Woman freed after hourslong standoff
entries.snippet: A man allegedly took a woman hostage in a supermarket, prompting a major police operation. The suspect reportedly "pulled out" a big knife before the supermarket closed on Friday evening.
